Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno; molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: max_phase_for_ind = 4; mesh_heading = 'Breast Cancer' OR efo_term = 'breast cancer'. Sort: chembl_id ASC, pref_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, indication_curie ASC, indication_label ASC, max_phase_for_ind ASC.
